## Audit scope and outcome

This is one completed K2 selection run, not a B0 baseline. The supplied record reports that the 526-word capability library was present in the actual prompt and first bridge request; its text is at `runs/capability_v1_selection_superjson-error-stack-serialization_K2_r1/infer_logs/superjson-error-stack-serialization/turn_1/loaded_capabilities.md`. The trajectory is in the same directory’s `trajs.json`; the official result is at `runs/capability_v1_selection_superjson-error-stack-serialization_K2_r1/eval_output/superjson-error-stack-serialization/eval_result.json` (both under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/`). No B0 trajectory was supplied, so baseline behavior cannot be assessed.

The official evaluation reports **formal success**, F2P 80/80 and P2P 116/116. Those are distinct from the student’s local checks, which included a repeatedly failing performance test. The run ended normally with `end_turn`, not a budget or technical stop, despite two locally observed compiler crashes.

## Exploration and changes

`main_agent` created branch `error-stack` and inspected the repository, Error serialization, tests, configuration and build commands (events 1–14). The first listing command partly failed because `less` was unavailable, after the branch was created (event 2). A pre-change build and executable probe showed the requested frame annotation was absent: the result had `Error`, with an undefined `stackFrames` annotation, rather than `Error/frames` (events 15–16).

The agent added `/app/src/error-options.ts`, `error-stack.ts`, `error-sanitizer.ts` and `error-class-registry.ts`, and changed `/app/src/index.ts` and `transformer.ts` (events 17–38). The final patch implements option normalization, stack string/frame processing, path and message redaction, cause handling, class filtering and processors, plus new Error annotations and deserialization. It committed the main change as `7f8c07f` (events 76–78). After that commit, it modified processed-annotation deserialization to restore causes across instances and committed `833fa38` (events 79–88).

There was additional work beyond the core serialization path: branch creation, formatting six files and a processor registry. The supplied record does not establish which of these were required by the original task, so they cannot all be labeled unnecessary. Formatting also changed unrelated layout in `index.ts` (events 54–56, 74). No persistent new test file appears in the final six-file patch; the focused tests were shell-executed probes.

## Validation, regressions and costs

Builds passed after retries and at the final cross-instance check (events 42, 56, 68, 85–86). TypeScript builds also segfaulted twice (events 39–40 and 64–66); their causes are not established. The first focused round trip passed for frames and a sanitized cause (events 44–46). A later probe covered root, array, object, Map and Set containers and passed (events 69–71). Its cross-instance check preceded a reversal of the cause condition at event 75; the subsequent annotation-specific fix was independently checked in events 85–86.

The existing local suite failed twice solely on its performance threshold: 2390 ms and then 2033 ms versus 700 ms; each run reported 81 passed, one failed, one skipped and one todo (events 43–45, 70–72). This is an observed local regression-test failure, not proof that the patch caused a performance regression: no comparable local baseline timing is shown. The student accurately reported the second result in event 89. The official success does not erase that local observation, and the record does not explain the difference between the local and official results.

One privacy-relevant limitation is visible in the passing probe: the serialized message was redacted, but raw stack-frame headers still contained the email and URL (event 46). The supplied record does not establish whether the task required those headers to be sanitized. The final implementation also applies line limits before stripping for strings but after stripping for frames (`/app/src/error-stack.ts`); the focused probe explicitly checked the resulting difference (events 64, 69–71), not general equivalence.

Reported resource use was 44 requested and returned tool calls, 21 model requests, 1,414,428 input and 7,500 output tokens, and 1,120.378 seconds selection wall time. SDK `total_cost_usd` of 7.25964 is a proxy estimate, not actual CLI billing; no actual dollar fee is established. The separate SDK duration is 839.54 seconds. These costs describe this run only.

## Capability assessment

The observed boundary and round-trip probes are executable behavior consistent with the library’s state-transition and representation guidance. They do not establish that the library caused the behavior: ordinary task-driven debugging could produce the same checks. The final statement’s claims of implementation and focused passes are supported by commands and results, rather than evidence of adoption by themselves. Read outputs and some edit/diff displays were truncated (notably events 12–14, 17, 20, 32 and 74); the supplied final patch fills in the final code, but not any unseen reasoning or omitted execution results.

| Capability/theme | Observed action | Agent/event IDs | Inference limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inspect state across transitions | Inspected serialized annotation and tested deserialization by another instance; fixed processed-cause restoration. | `main_agent` 15–16, 79–86 | Consistent with checking a consumer boundary; not evidence of library causation or exhaustive boundary coverage. |
| Identity and failure feedback | Checked cause object type and message through a round trip; build and suite failures were reported. | `main_agent` 69–72, 85–89 | No request/response identifier tracing, worker-failure or unknown-target exercise is visible; that delegation-oriented advice is only indirectly applicable. |
| Carry input contracts into later use | Normalized options and checked null input, container types and a fresh deserializer. | `main_agent` 17, 64, 69–71, 85–86 | No evidence of a learned persistent input schema, input reordering or comprehensive missing/extra-input checks; this capability is only partially analogous. |
| Preserve meaning when changing representation | Tested frame annotation, reconstructed stack and causes, and ran existing regressions. | `main_agent` 15–16, 44–46, 69–72, 85–86 | No idempotence or broad semantic-equivalence test is visible; sanitization intentionally changes some content. Local performance test failed. |
| Claims, truncation and outcome | Student claimed build and focused passes and disclosed the local failure; official evaluator separately reported full F2P/P2P success. | `main_agent` 89; evaluation path above | Claim is corroborated for displayed checks, not every configuration. Truncated trajectory displays limit reconstruction; official success is not evidence of capability adoption or long-term generality. |
